ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

SPEED LIMIT (KUCHAI LINK 2 RAMP) ORDER 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 69(2) of the

Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Speed Limit (Kuchai Link 2 Ramp)

Order 2020.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 12 November 2020.

Prohibition

2. (1) The driving of a motor vehicle at a speed exceeding the speed limit

specified in column (2) of the First Schedule on the road specified in column (1) of the

First Schedule is prohibited.

(2) The road with speed limit as specified under subparagraph (1) is shown

on the map in the Second Schedule.
